_comment: Example for agentic_rl_data/configs/pipeline.json -> build_raw.cfg_json. Shape: {source_name: loader_cfg}. Each loader accepts `records` (inline list), `path`/`raw_path`/`file`/`dir` (local file or directory), or `hf_dataset`/`dataset` (+ optional `hf_config`, `split`, `streaming`). Sources omitted here fall back to the loader's default HuggingFace id (needs `datasets` + network). Paths are resolved relative to the repo root.
